333:1050014.name: "Why do we believe simplicity is beautiful? Because with physical products, we need to feel in control. When you create order from complexity, you find a way to make the product serve you. Simplicity isn't just a visual style or minimalism—it's not about reducing clutter. You must truly understand a product's essence to distill it down to what matters."
